evidence_note: Stage 1 North opened Dec 2025; Central and South packages remain under construction.

value_scope: Combined value of four signed delivery contracts only; not total project cost

evidence_note: 6.5 km twin motorway tunnel; 2026 TBM excavation includes final 1.5 km harbour section.

name: HumeLink

value_scope: Project cost reported by Victoria's Big Build
